notes.note: Scoped post-merge startup cleanup review: moved Claude startup cleanup into the existing method, removing an added async boundary that reordered session.state-changed before turn.started. Early refusal still revokes session proxy authority; normal startup preserves the original event ordering. EXECUTED: the regression was observed in the full provider suite, then all 417 Claude adapter and confinement tests passed after repair. Main merge changes package-release metadata, not this proxy protocol. Existing OAuth, ownership and UI statements retain their scope; no new live-provider, kernel or hosted acceptance is claimed.
